text: なみだが　でて　きおった…

patterns.name: 〜てくる
patterns.explanation: てくる after a verb says something starts and comes toward you. でて　きおった = 'have started coming out'.

patterns.name: 〜おる
patterns.explanation: おる stuck onto a verb is an old-man way of speaking that adds a grumbling or rueful tone about what happened. きおった = 'went and came'.
